note: The town's quests. type: main (violet) or side (yellow). Objective types so far: talk (talk to `npc`) and chooseClass. autoStart quests start the first time a player is in town (and for anyone who hasn't done them yet). dialogue: lines the giver says instead of their usual ones while the quest is on: talk (in order, while talking is the current objective), remind (talking again before the next objective is done), complete (when the quest is done; {class} is the class's name). rewards: items given into the combat bag when it's completed ({ item: an items.json or equipment.json id, count }); a quest finished before it had rewards gives them on the next visit. Every quest up to Lv 20 gives Low HP and MP Potions.

quests.title: A Weapon for the Town
quests.summary: The Tanod needs help keeping Mikazuki safe at night. Talk to him and choose how you'll fight.

talk: Hey, a new face! Welcome to Mikazuki.
Our town is quiet at night, but past the fence, the monsters are wide awake.
We tanods can't handle it all. We need your help.
Every watchman has a weapon. It doesn't have to be fancy, as long as you can protect your neighbours.
Pick one. Try it out before you decide, okay?
remind: So, have you picked one yet?
complete: Nice! A {class} watchman. Stay safe, okay? If there's trouble, I'm right here.
